signature.scope: Exploratory interventions motivated by original-seed error decomposition. Reflection explicitly imposes orthogonality and involution; it does not prove discovered algebraic laws. Additional source seeds are fixed in advance and all completed outcomes reported.
signature.hyperparameter_selection: Only source-training known generator edges and known-state validation. Select the smallest cap with validation squared error within 5% of the best candidate, including an uncapped refitted-bias candidate. No compound test or hidden-answer selection.
